item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Tribunal Electoral's final computation recorded Andrés Manuel López Obrador as the majority candidate in the 2018 presidential election with 30,110,327 votes out of 56,601,874 total votes, with totals derived from district counts and overseas votes.","notes":["The excerpt says votes emitted/total votes, not 'validly counted votes.'","The excerpt does not explicitly document totals by state."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A Nexos analysis stated that the obradorismo movement attacked or weakened judicial and autonomous oversight institutions through proposed reforms, budget reductions, denunciations, threats of political trial, and partisan appointments; it described resistance by the INE and Supreme Court, the CNDH's alleged loss of independence, and Arturo Zaldívar's leadership as accommodating toward López Obrador.","notes":["The excerpt attributes the attacks specifically to 'el obradorismo,' not expressly to the government as such."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Nexos analyses stated that austerity and anti-corruption policies did not produce lower spending, greater efficiency, or less corruption, and instead helped centralize decisions and reassign resources outside legislative control. The excerpt reports 1,014 million million pesos in additional executive spending and 4,203 million million pesos redirected between 2019 and 2022, plus more than 5 million million pesos redirected during the first five years and major projects costing more than 1.2 trillion pesos.","notes":["'Quadrillion' is not supported by the excerpt's Mexican 'millones de millones' wording; the summary must retain the source's units.","The excerpt says the projects cost more than 1.2 billones, not 'almost three times' in the supplied passage."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A Nexos account reported that Morena presidential aspirants used extensive public-space advertising during the 2023 succession process, were described as conducting an early precampaign, and in practice escaped the rigorous fiscal oversight normally applied to precandidacies; the sources of financing were not known.","notes":["The excerpt does not explicitly state that the aspirants lacked precampaign registration; it states that they escaped the normal fiscalization process."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E014","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"During the reporting period, López Obrador's administration left IFT and COFECE without functioning plenaries by not filling vacancies; after a Supreme Court order, López Obrador appointed three COFECE commissioners. The administration also supported dissolving INAI, which remained institutionally impaired during the period.","notes":["The exact excerpt supports the IFT and COFECE appointment failures, while the INAI claim appears in the supplied excerpt only through the separate subsequent reference context."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E016","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E017","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E018","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E019","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E020","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E021","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E022","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
